lesson: A bounded paid-agent experiment needs an explicit action-turn contract in addition to tool schemas. A model can spend multiple turns on diagnostics and then emit prose-only planning without invoking the training tool; treating that as scientific non-adherence confounds protocol nonexecution with the target causal endpoint.
design_rule: Before a future paid PRE unit, preregister a general arm-invariant turn protocol specifying whether each nonterminal provider response must issue a tool call, how prose-only planning is fed back, and the maximum diagnostic-turn budget. Freeze this before any new outcome and apply it identically to PRE/POST/control arms.
anti_overfit_rule: Do not repair by task hopping, exposing hidden test examples, forcing the desired RL action, or selecting a new prompt after seeing which strategy would make the candidate succeed.
